businesses.name: Black Swan Yoga
businesses.description: Black Swan Yoga is a donation-based, 90-degree heated yoga studio that is approachable, affordable, and community-driven. They honor all yogic styles, practices, and philosophies, believing yoga should be available to everyone.

businesses.name: Yoga Yoga North
businesses.description: Yoga Yoga offers a variety of yoga classes and styles, catering to all levels from beginners to experienced practitioners. They are committed to providing a welcoming and supportive environment for their community.

businesses.name: Practice Yoga Austin
businesses.description: Practice Yoga Austin is a donation-based yoga studio focused on high-quality yoga accessible to all. They offer a variety of classes including Align, Vinyasa, Mindful Yoga, Yin, meditation, and breathwork in a welcoming atmosphere.
businesses.hours: Monday-Thursday: 7:00 am - 11:00 pm, Friday: 7:00 am - 7:30 pm, Saturday: 9:00 am - 7:30 pm, Sunday: 9:00 am - 10:00 pm

businesses.name: Austin Yoga Tree
businesses.description: Austin Yoga Tree is a yoga studio offering various classes like Vinyasa Flow, Vinyasa Flow + Weights, Pranayama, and Meditation. They emphasize community and a lifelong learning journey in yoga.

businesses.name: CorePower Yoga - Monarch
businesses.description: CorePower Yoga offers a physically challenging workout rooted in the mindfulness of yoga, with classes like Yoga, Hot Yoga, and Strength Training. They aim to share the transformative power of yoga with everyone.

businesses.name: Yoga Pod Austin
businesses.description: Yoga Pod Austin offers a variety of classes including Hot Yoga, Vinyasa, Barre, and fitness classes in a welcoming and inclusive environment. They provide a robust class schedule for all levels.
